title: Top Android Phones to Buy Right Now (2026)
summary: The Galaxy S26 Ultra is the best premium Android phone, the OnePlus 15 leads on battery, the Pixel 10 Pro on AI and the Pixel 10a on value.
method: Picks come from TechRadar, Tom's Guide, Android Central, PhoneArena and T3. Only phones named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because phone prices and deals change often. Newer phones such as the Pixel 11 series and Galaxy Z Fold 8 have launched, and some roundups haven't fully updated, so check the latest models too.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
why: Tom's Guide names the Galaxy S26 Ultra the best Android phone overall and the most capable you can buy. PhoneArena calls it the best premium all-rounder, TechRadar the Android camera phone to beat, and T3 gave it its 2026 Best Phone award.
Android Central highlights the Privacy Display, wider camera apertures for low light and 60W fast wired charging.
pros: Best camera versatility and low-light performance
products.best_for: Anyone who wants the best all-round Android phone
products.skip_if: You want to spend less or prefer a smaller phone

products.name: OnePlus 15
why: TechRadar names the OnePlus 15 its best overall Android phone and gave it a perfect score, praising its durability and battery life. Tom's Guide lists it as the longest-lasting and best fast-charging Android phone.
Android Central also names the OnePlus 15 among its top picks.
specs: Fast charging that beats any Samsung phone (TechRadar)
cons: Camera is not the top pick (TechRadar gives that to Samsung)
products.best_for: People who want the best battery and fast charging
products.skip_if: The best camera is your top priority

products.name: Google Pixel 10 Pro / Pro XL
products.badge: Best for AI and clean software
why: TechRadar names the Pixel 10 Pro and Pro XL the best Android phones for AI, because Google's own phones get new AI and Android features first. Tom's Guide calls the Pixel 10 Pro XL the AI phone to beat.
PhoneArena describes the Pixel 10 Pro XL as a 6.8-inch OLED phone with strong Gemini AI that is one of the best Android phones.
specs: Pixel 10 Pro and Pro XL sizes
cons: Newer Pixel 11 phones have since launched (Android Central)
products.best_for: People who want Google's AI and software
products.skip_if: You want the longest battery or the best zoom camera

products.name: Google Pixel 10a
why: TechRadar says the Pixel 10a now holds its spot as the best budget Android phone. Tom's Guide lists the Pixel 10a as its best value Android phone.
It brings Google's clean software to a lower price.
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want a good Android phone
products.skip_if: You want flagship cameras and performance
